lines.en: My long neck passes the treetops
Four pillar legs press the ground

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都倒了
lines.en: The grass lies down where I pass

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪着巨大的身子
lines.en: I shift my huge body slowly
My tail drags a furrow
I raise my head for high leaves
Each step shakes the earth
My shadow covers half the grove
I pass slowly along the stream
I lower my neck and raise it
I lower my head and tear up grass
I move slowly under the canopy

lines.zh: 我的影子在林子里移动
lines.en: My shadow moves through the grove
My neck sways slowly
I chew very slowly
One foot rests on a stone
I rest under the canopy
Deep folds run over my hide
The topmost leaves are mine.
I am not chasing anyone
I lift my head to the sky
My tail swings to and fro
I sniff at the bark
I pull a branch down
I slowly turn to stand another way
I lower my long neck at you
You are so small beneath me
What do you want from me
My head comes slowly closer
You stand there without moving
I huff a breath at you
My forefoot rests beside you
You are on my shadow
I raise my head back up
I lower my head and sniff you
A mark stays on my leg
I swing my long neck
I raise my head higher
My four legs are still firm
I do not want a fight
Hit me again and I answer

lines.zh: 你的刀，连我的皮都嫌浅。
lines.en: Your blade barely reaches my hide.

lines.zh: 惹我一下，这片林子都听得见。
lines.en: Cross me once and the whole jungle hears it.
You hold up leaves
I dip my long neck to sniff
I can eat this one
Is there more from higher up
I take one leaf slowly
Raise it to where I can bend
My head can reach your hand
I stretch my neck for it
You pass the leaves down to me
You hit my pillar leg
Your shoulder strikes my ankle.
You are the one who bounces
My leg is hard as a trunk

lines.zh: 丛林的长脖子，挪开一点。
lines.en: A jungle long-neck shifts a little.
Your hat goes flying
I set my foot further off
That did not startle me
My leg shifts on the ground

lines.zh: 我的长颈垂下来，挡了路。
lines.en: My long neck lowers and blocks the way.
There are other long necks here
I hear a low call far off

lines.zh: 我们隔着树冠互相看见
lines.en: We see each other over the canopy
Her neck is a little shorter
We share this stand of trees
That need not be hurried
We cross the meadow together
She is unhurried, and so am I
Her prints press shallower
We walk and graze side by side
I curl my lips around it
It breaks between my teeth
I chew twice and swallow
I only sniffed at it
I prefer leaves
I kick the stone away
I sweep up a mouthful of grass
I bring it to my mouth
You entered this stand of trees
My neck is coming down
My forefoot is up
You have spoiled my trees
I turn by slow degrees
I use only half my strength
You are within my neck's reach
I take two long strides in
This foot lands heavy
You should not have touched those trees
I lower my head to my shoulder
Move aside and I stay put
You've snapped my ferns.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴也要扫过去了
lines.en: My tail comes round too
I press in slowly

lines.zh: 我的脖子从上面探下来
lines.en: My neck reaches down from above
You cannot escape my shadow

lines.zh: 我把巨大的身子转过来
lines.en: I turn my great body around
No hurry, my stride is wide
You will not leave this grove
My tail sweeps the grass flat
Do you hear my tread
One stride brings me to you
A root trips you up
My head stays turned to you
Vines cover your way back
My long neck lowers slowly

lines.zh: 你在我影子靠边的位置
lines.en: You are at the edge of my shadow
This foot of mine lands loudly
My forefoot comes down
I swing my neck and head at you
I turn and shove you with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我踩在你旁边震得你失衡
lines.en: My step by you knocks you off balance
I push you off with my brow
The shock bounces you up

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了半边力
lines.en: That was only half my strength

lines.zh: 我的脚落下时土都飞了
lines.en: Soil flies where my foot lands

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，整个人滑开
lines.en: You block and slide away whole
My other foot comes up
My neck whips into you
My foot sinks into the ground
I swing my head and knock you away
My tail flattens a swath of grass
I raise a forefoot and drop it
The canopy shakes first
I come out from between the trees
My long neck rises over the trees
The ground judders

lines.zh: 我的影子先压到草地上
lines.en: My shadow reaches the grass first
I strip a whole branch of leaves
I raise my head over the canopy
Four feet press the grass flat
I break a fallen log underfoot
I halt and watch you
A low call comes from far off

lines.zh: 我的头从树隙间探出来
lines.en: My head comes through a gap in the trees
The woods quiet when I set foot down
Leaves cling to my neck
I come up slowly from the water
This grove stands lower than I do

lines.zh: 火燎焦了我脖子上的皮
lines.en: Fire singes the skin on my neck

lines.zh: 我从高处下来震了一震
lines.en: The drop shakes me through
Water reaches my chest
The blast shoves me askew

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我厚厚的皮
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my thick hide
Magic coils around my neck
I have stripped these trees bare
Lightning runs down my spine

lines.zh: 我这么大的身子也留不住
lines.en: Even this bulk cannot hold on
